entries.label: Trajectory Research
entries.summary: Pesquisa estruturada com trajetorias, evidencias, citacoes, relatorios e export para training.

entries.summary: Memoria ativa que decide o que lembrar/esquecer em tempo real com decay de importancia e consolidacao automatica.

entries.label: Diagnostics Prometheus
entries.summary: Export de metricas no formato Prometheus com counters, gauges, histograms e servidor HTTP /metrics.
details: 20+ metricas built-in, labels, histogram buckets, endpoint /metrics e /health.

entries.label: Provider Novita AI
entries.summary: Acesso a modelos open-source baratos via API Novita (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Deepseek, Yi, Phi).

entries.label: Browser Playwright
entries.summary: Automacao de navegador via Playwright com navigate, screenshot, extract, PDF e multi-tab.

entries.label: Search Exa
entries.summary: Busca semantica neural via Exa com findSimilar e getContents para pesquisa profunda.

entries.label: Kanban Dispatcher
entries.summary: Kanban SQLite-backed com dispatcher multi-agent, auto-blocking, priorizacao e dispatch paralelo.
details: Colunas customizaveis, bloqueio automatico, dispatch por prioridade, max concurrent.

entries.label: Security Guidance
entries.summary: Consulta interativa de politicas de seguranca, OWASP Top 10, code scanning e hardening guide.

details: txt2img, img2img, inpaint, upscale. Rode tudo localmente.

entries.label: Memory Qdrant
entries.summary: Qdrant — vector DB production-grade para busca semantica com collections, filtragem e CRUD.

entries.label: Disk Cleanup
entries.summary: Limpeza automatica de disco com regras configuraveis, scan, dry-run e relatorio de uso.
details: 7 regras built-in, glob patterns, usage report.

entries.label: Codex Supervisor
entries.summary: Supervisao de execucao de comandos com timeout, retries, concorrencia controlada e logging.
details: Max concurrent, timeout, auto-retry, stdout/stderr logging.

recipes.label: Core MCP Adoption

Use o plane para acompanhar trust e estado de instalacao dos servidores MCP.
details: Ajuda a tornar o tool plane mais explicito e mais proximo de um marketplace operacional.
